description: Гном-чемпион из Эребора. Неудержимый воин щитом, топором и арбалетом.

skills.name: War-cry
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost: 15 power 
Press RT + B to temporarily increase Armor, Health, and melee damage.
Note: Can be enhanced by the following skills: Dwarf Armor, Taunt, Retaliation, Fortitude, Abundant Harm, Indomitable Spirit, Battle Fury, and Battle-ready
Armor of equipment is increased by 100% of the base armor.
Health is increased by 25% of the base health

skills.name: Dwarf Armor
skills.description:
Passive Skill
War-cry allows the Dwarf to ignore heavy hit reactions and also increases the Armor of nearby party members.
Note: War-cry must be active for effect. Higher ranks increase the shared Armor bonus.
 Ignore heavier hit reactions  means that you gain resistance to flinching effects while under the effects of War-cry.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost:  power
While blocking press LB + Y to stun your target. Also increases the Armor from shields.  Requires a Shield 
Note: Additional ranks increase Armor bonus from shields.

skills.name: Mighty Reach
skills.description:
Passive Skill
Increases the range and damage of your Sweeping Attack, Earthshaker, and Whirlwind skills.
Note: Additional ranks increase the attack range and damage.

skills.name: Fortitude
skills.description:
Passive Skill
Upon activation War-cry grants temporary combat Health regeneration for the Dwarf and any party members.
Note: War-cry must be active for effect. Higher ranks increase the shared Health rengeration rate.

skills.name: Heavy Weapons
skills.description:
Passive Skill
Increases the damage you cause with 2-handed melee weapons
Note: Additional ranks increase damage
 Effect: +6 melee attack with 2h-weapons for each skill point
 Maximum : 3 skillpoints (+18 melee damage)
Legendary Difficulty:
 Effect: +140 melee attack with 2h-weapons for each skill point
 Maximum : 3 skillpoints (+420 melee damage)

skills.name: Sweeping Attack
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost: 15
Press RT+X to strike out at multiple enemies over a wide area.
Note: Can be followed with the Whirlwind and Earthshaker skills for additional effect.

skills.name: Battle Fury
skills.description:
Passive Skill
Increases the War-cry damage bonus and increases the melee damage done by nearby party members while active.
Note: War-cry must be active for effects. Higher ranks increases damage bonus.

skills.name: Impact
skills.description:
Passive skill
Upgrades the damage of the devastating Crushing Blow and Crushing Wave attacks.
Note: Additional ranks increase damage.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description:
Passive Skill
War-cry now shifts enemy focus to the Dwarf, damages nearby enemies and increases the damage they take.
Note: War-cry must be active for effect. Higher ranks add larger area of effect range and additional damage.

skills.name: Determination
skills.description:
Passive skill
Reduces the cooldown of your active skills.
Note: Additional ranks further reduce active skill cooldown times.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost: 19
Hold RT + X to follow Sweeping Attack with a continuous flurry of quick area attacks. Requires a Sword 
Note: Continuing to hold RT + X allows Whirlwind to persist. Additional ranks increase damage from attacks.

skills.name: Crushing Blow
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost: 15 power
Press RT + Y to strike a single melee target for high damage.
Note: Can be upgraded by the Crushing Wave skill.
The damage done by this skill is the total melee damage plus 150% of the total melee damage.
Equation: Total melee damage (Min. or Max) x 2.5 = Total Damage for Crushing Blow

skills.name: Crossbow Adept
skills.description:
Passive Skill
The crossbow is upgraded from single-shot to rapid firing, multiple bolt capability.
Note: Additional ranks increase bolt capacity for rapid firing.
Rank 1 - +3 additional bolts 
Rank 2 - +2 additional bolts

skills.name: Heavy Bolt
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost: 19 power
LT + RB fires a precise high damage bolt at your target.
Note: Additional ranks increase bolt damage.
The damage done by this skill is the total ranged damage plus 100% of the total ranged damage.
Rank 1 - +100% of total ranged damage
Rank 2 - +120% of total ranged damage
Rank 3 - +140% of total ranged damage
Equation: Total ranged damage (Min. or Max) + Rank (1, 2, or 3) = Total Damage for Heavy Bolt

skills.name: Retaliation
skills.description:
Passive Skill
During War-cry, melee damage absorbed by the Champion is reflected back to the enemy.
Note: War-cry must be active for effect. Reflected damage is a percentage of your total Armor. Each rank adds damage.
The percentage is 12% of your total armor
Rank 1 - 12% of total armor
Rank 2 - 24% of total armor
Rank 3 - 36% of total armor
Equation: Total armor x Rank (1, 2, or 3) = Total damage

skills.name: Shield Charge
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost:  power
While blocking press LB + B to charge violently ahead, knocking enemies aside and damaging them. Requires a Shield 
Note: Higher ranks increase the damage dealt.

skills.name: Abundant Harm
skills.description:
Passive Skill
During War-cry your melee attacks will echo to nearby enemies, striking them for damage.
Note: War-cry must be active for effect. Additional ranks add more targets.

skills.name: Indomitable Spirit
skills.description:
Passive Skill
Active War-cry near a fallen ally to instantly revive them.
Note: Higher ranks give more Health to the revived ally.

skills.name: Explosive Bolt
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost:  power
LT + X fires an explosive bolt that detontes upon impact.
Note: Additional ranks increase the damage from impact.
This ability is very powerful, especially when uppgraded. It may even be said that it is downright overpowered as it creates such a large and high damage explosion from a distance. It can wipe out groups of enemies and do noteworhty damage to trolls and other heavy opponents.

skills.name: Crushing Wave
skills.description:
Active Skill
Cost: ??? power
Enhance Crushing Blow (RT + Y) with a devastating wave of damage extending ahead of the champion.
Note:Higher ranks add damage.

skills.name: Battle-ready
skills.description:
Passive Skill
Skills used while War-cry is active cost less power
Note: War-cry must be active for effects. Higher ranks further decrease skill costs.
Decreases the cost by 25% per level.
Rank 1 - 25%
Rank 2 - 50%
